plain_english_policy: This bill directs state funding to the Coalition Against Domestic Violence by establishing strict financial and operational oversight requirements. The policy direction is one of conditional appropriation: funds will only be released if the organization first submits an operations plan for the upcoming fiscal year (2010-2011) and a fully audited financial statement from the previous period (2008-2009). Once funded, the coalition must provide quarterly reports detailing actual spending and accomplishments, as well as an end-of-year performance report that specifically cites 'meaningful measures of program effectiveness.' The bill effectively shifts state policy toward increased accountability for non-state agencies receiving public funds by mandating regular reporting to the Director of Finance.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would result in a $435,600 appropriation from the State General Fund to the Coalition Against Domestic Violence for fiscal year ending September 30, 2011. The policy outcome includes mandatory pre-funding submission of an operations plan and audited financial statement, followed by ongoing quarterly reporting on expenditures and accomplishments, culminating in a final performance report citing specific measures of program effectiveness.
sponsorship_supports_position: Representatives Knight, Love, Canfield, Newton (D) and Boyd
